description: Call this BEFORE building a new product, feature or prototype, when what to build and for whom isn't settled. Returns the Product thinking workflow: who it's for (one person in one situation, never invented), the problem behind the request, what success looks like, and what not to build. Small changes to an existing product get a two-line check instead. Free: the workflow, the first step and the core rules; the other rules are ihumane Pro and are named by title.

task.description: What you've been asked to build, e.g. 'a habit tracker app' or 'add team sharing to the notes app'

name: ihumane_product_start
